overall_assessment: The institutional governance and data handling subsystem implemented across searchright-governance and searchright-contracts provides deterministic, deny-by-default policy evaluation. The InstitutionalPolicy contract binds permitted deployment modes (LocalOnly, InstitutionSelfHosted, HostedSingleTenant, HostedMultiTenant), allowed classifications, permitted ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 regions, maximum retention periods, and explicit permissions for telemetry, external model processing, and cross-border transfers. The evaluation engine in evaluate() enforces hard boundaries: unapproved deployment modes, disallowed classifications, retention requests exceeding maximum policy bounds, unapproved external model operations, and missing or disallowed processing regions result in deterministic blocking reason codes (e.g., governance.deployment_mode.denied, governance.classification.denied, governance.retention.exceeds_policy, governance.telemetry.denied, governance.external_model.denied, governance.region.denied, governance.region.required). Hosted multi-tenant deployments handling non-public metadata are explicitly blocked under governance.multi_tenant.isolation_unproven. Furthermore, high-risk data classifications (Confidential, RestrictedFullText, SensitivePersonalData) mandate explicit human governance approval unless running in non-authorising dry-run preview mode. The suite of 29 unit tests and 29 comprehensive integration scenario tests confirms fail-closed behavior across all evaluation paths.
verified_invariants: deny-by-default deployment boundary: requests specifying unapproved deployment modes fail closed with governance.deployment_mode.denied
data classification gating: requests exceeding permitted classifications are blocked under governance.classification.denied
maximum retention bounding: requests specifying retention exceeding maximum_retention_days fail closed with governance.retention.exceeds_policy
telemetry and external model gating: telemetry and third-party hosted model execution are blocked unless explicitly permitted by policy
geographic and regional sovereignty: unpermitted or cross-border processing without authorization is blocked with governance.region.denied or governance.cross_border_transfer.denied
multi-tenant isolation enforcement: hosted multi-tenant processing of non-public review data is rejected with governance.multi_tenant.isolation_unproven
human approval mandate: high-risk classifications require recorded human governance authority prior to effect application
preview non-authorization: dry-run evaluations produce non-authorising decisions accompanied by governance.dry_run.no_effects warnings

findings.description: Integration scenarios in crates/searchright-governance/tests/governance_scenarios.rs thoroughly test policy denial codes; institutional legal, privacy, and security reviews for specific production enterprise deployments remain open as formal deployment gates.
findings.recommendation: Preserve gate T28-G-INSTITUTIONAL-REVIEW open until pilot enterprise deployments complete security sign-off.

findings.description: All ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region codes are strictly validated to be 2 uppercase ASCII characters, preventing region spoofing or casing ambiguities across jurisdictional rules.
findings.recommendation: Continue enforcing upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 validation in all downstream adapter schemas.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Institutional policy and data-handling decision contracts are mutually consistent, fully validated, and enforced deny-by-default across 29 unit tests and 29 scenario tests.
Data classification, purpose, storage, regional, and retention rules are explicitly bounded and verified to fail closed upon any policy violation.

limitations: Source-verified and fixture-proven implementation only; live multi-tenant production hosting and formal institutional legal certification remain open gates.
